column1: # Starter URL-domain -> class rules. Hand-assigned 2026-10-07; NOT reviewed.
# Matching: a rule matches a URL whose host equals `domain` or is a
# subdomain of it, and whose path starts with `path_prefix` (empty = any).
# The most specific rule wins: longest domain, then longest path prefix.
#   lcc       LCC class, or `=arxiv` (resolve the arXiv ID through
#             arxiv-lcc.tsv; the domain alone says nothing)
#   ddc       DDC number (numbers only, never captions), or empty
#   strength  decide = the domain alone is enough to place the Work;
#             hint   = a prior for later tiers, never decides alone
